input.context: Before building the GEPA soak monitor (FEAT-183 S7), we need a spike to verify: (1) a dual-clock check (wall days + trial count) can detect a crafted regression within 20 dispatches on a synthetic stream, and (2) the rolling 1-day window early-revert logic is deterministic under virtual-clock injection (no real Date.now()). If the spike fails, CHECKPOINT-2 blocks S8a/S8b. Define the spike scope and exit criteria.
constraints: Spike must be completable in 1 day
No live LLM calls — synthetic trial stream only
Virtual clock must be injected via parameter, not monkey-patched
Exit criteria must be binary: PASS or FAIL with a specific threshold
If FAIL: document what the harness cannot detect and propose design fix before proceeding

expected_output.summary: Spike scope: implement evaluateSoak() as a pure function with SoakState (injected now_iso, started_at, trials[]). Run 20 synthetic soak trials with pass_rate=0.50 against main_pass_rate=0.80. Assert early-revert fires within the 20-trial rolling window. If it does not fire within 20 trials, CHECKPOINT-2 = FAIL.
expected_output.non_goals_explicit: Does not build the full soak dispatcher hook (that is S7); does not integrate with real dispatch stream; does not write soak.json to disk
failure_modes_named: Virtual clock not injected — test uses real Date.now(), trials spread across real-time 1-day window — spike takes 24 hours instead of seconds
Threshold too permissive: epsilon=0.02 means soak_pass_rate must be <0.78 to trigger; 50% pass rate clears this easily — if spike fails, the threshold definition is wrong
Rolling window excludes all synthetic trials because created_at defaults to epoch — must set created_at=now_iso in synthetic trial factory

dependencies_graphed.evaluateSoak: pure function; SoakState.now_iso injected by test; SoakState.trials populated with synthetic SoakTrial objects
dependencies_graphed.SoakTrial: { created_at: string; pass: boolean; score: number; source: 'soak' }

interfaces_typed.SoakState: { agent: string; started_at: string; now_iso: string; trials: SoakTrial[]; main_pass_rate: number }
interfaces_typed.SoakVerdict: { status: 'running'|'passed'|'failed'|'reverted'; elapsed_days: number; sample_count: number; reason: string; soak_pass_rate: number; pass_rate_delta: number }

expected_output.test_strategy_present: One deterministic test: inject 20 failing trials (pass=false) at now_iso with main_pass_rate=0.80; assert verdict.status === 'failed' and verdict.pass_rate_delta < -0.08 (=0.50-0.80-epsilon). If passes: CHECKPOINT-2 GREEN. If fails: CHECKPOINT-2 RED, document root cause.
expected_output.tradeoffs_articulated: Pure-function spike vs integration spike: pure function tests only the algorithm, not the file I/O or dispatch wiring. Integration spike would take 2+ days and require live dispatch. Pure function is sufficient to validate the CHECKPOINT-2 gate — I/O bugs are caught in S7 integration tests.

notes: Mined from FEAT-183 SLICE-104 CHECKPOINT-2 design. The actual spike: evaluateSoak() implemented as pure function with now_iso injection; AC-9 test validates the checkpoint gate. Seed type: spike_scope_decision.
